name: Zaizen Eba
source:
Typical asocial type.
Reason for wanting to die: Has no hope for the future.
Lingering attachment to this world: Wants to show filial piety to his parents.

An introverted, timid, and gloomy high school freshman, member of the manga club. He’s a kind person who loves his family but tends to lose sight of himself as a result of being too self-conscious. He has the bad habit of behaving according to what others say around him. He compares himself with other people who are the same age as him on social media, and puts himself down because of it. Besides this, he loves the well-known mascot Aopero-chan dearly.

On social media, he seems to be particularly interested in animal pictures and information related to the arts. Not very good at participating in everyday conversations, but may take the initiative when it comes to certain topics. If it’s about his favourite things, he talks fast and his face lights up instantly. 

He is the only child in a family of three, living with his parents.

[Adapted from [url=http://clubsuicide.net]the official website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/_MORPATH?s=20&t=j3Xffhv5h-Yo19sJry3tvA]Twitter[/url].]
